Name: SH's More Adoptable Animals (More Custom Pets)
Author: plurffle
Description:
Ever wanted to keep some of the animals from my previous mods, Wild Animals and Domestic Animals, in your farm with you? Well now you can!

With the new 1.6 update, it's been made easier to make custom pets. So... Here's some of my own! :D There are over 30+ animals that you can adopt as pets into your game (some with coat variations, which adds to more pets to choose from), all with customized gifts and prices (adoption prices are configurable in the mod's config).

[b]Q: I experienced a bug! What should I do?[/b]
[b]A:[/b][b] [/b]First, please do read the rest of the FAQ here in case there is an answer already provided and to also check the main page/Comments section of the mod in case I have listed the bug as a "known issue". If neither of them has the solution, feel free to comment the bug in the Comments sections or over in the Bugs section.

[b]Q: Does this replace any of the pets in-game?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Nope. All of these animals here are their own pets and [b]do not[/b] replace any files or pets that you may already have.

[b]Q: Is this compatible with 1.5, mobile, or multiplayer?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Since the ability to add new pets was added in the 1.6 update, this mod [b]will not[/b] work in other versions of the game. I have no idea if this mod works in mobile and multiplayer since I have no way of testing that, but I'd assume it should work.

[b]Q: How do I gain access to adopting these animals?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] You need to reach max friendship with your first pet before you'll have access to a pet license, which allows you to visit Marnie and adopt more pets. If you feel like some of their prices are too expensive, the amount can be changed in this mod's config.
